files.content:
# Pixel Memory Match

A simple, offline memory-match game with 8 pairs of colored cards. Flip two cards at a time, match pairs, count moves, and win!

## Features
- 8 pairs of colored cards (16 total) shuffled each game
- Move counter
- Win message and New Game button
- Keyboard accessible (cards are buttons, focusable and operable)
- Responsive design from 360px wide
- No external dependencies or network requests

## How to Run
1. Open `index.html` in any modern browser.
2. Click or press Enter/Space on cards to flip them.
3. Match all pairs to win!

## Files
- `index.html` – main structure
- `styles.css` – styling and animations
- `script.js` – game logic
